sections.Profile:
Miss-O (1969) and Cue-T (1968) are electro-mechanical pinball machines produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. Both share a billiards theme and a similar playfield layout designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche. Miss-O is the replay version, while Cue-T is the add-a-ball variant.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1968–1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pool (Billiards), Sports, Original Theme, Robots, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Norm Clark
- Art: Christian Marche
